messages:
sara-sales: Quick sync — ACME POC. Need to lock down deliverables, success criteria, timeline, and who owns what. Can we commit to a 3-week POC with two milestones? @mike-se @anika-eng @oliver-ps

mike-se: We can do 3 weeks but need clarity on scope. Can you confirm target workload: chat completions only, or embeddings + rerank? Also any data residency constraints?

sara-sales: Primary goal = chat integration (customer service triage) + embedding search for KB. Must demo end-to-end: prompt -> response -> logging for quality checks. No on-prem required; must pass security Q by EOW.

anika-eng: Sounds fine. For 3 weeks I suggest milestones: Week 1: infra + model selection + baseline prompts. Week 2: integrate streaming + KV cache + collect eval prompts. Week 3: run evals, performance tuning, handover. We’ll need an SE for demos and one engineer for infra/debugging.

oliver-ps: I can cover the SE demo side, 8 hours/week. Need clarity on the acceptance criteria for quality — what scores do they expect on the eval set? Also any SLA requirements for latency?

sara-sales: ACME expects sub-500ms median for typical 256-token responses in demo env. For quality: they want at least 85% on intent classification and 90% precision on top-1 KB retrieval. We should define a small prompt eval set (20 prompts) to validate.

mike-se: OK re: infra — recommend model variants: gpt-3.5-like open model for baseline, then quantized high-perf for latency tests. Will need Dedicated capacity for load testing (can provision a small pool). Cost estimate?

anika-eng: Rough estimate: Dedicated 1x A100 equiv for week 2 load tests (~$6k/week). If we keep hosted for baseline and only spin Dedicated for performance run, we can stay within ~$8k total infra. SE time is billable; recommend including 12 hrs of SE + 24 hrs eng in POC quote.

sara-sales: I'll draft a one-pager POC SOW. Items to include: scope, timeline, acceptance criteria, resource matrix, security Q owner, pricing estimate. Need sign-off by Fri.

james-legal: Quick note — we need to log the security Q responses into the workspace and flag any items that require Legal review (e.g., data retention, subprocessor list). Please tag me on the final doc.

oliver-ps: For deliverables I propose: 1) Working demo app (chat + KB search), 2) Eval report (20 prompts + metrics), 3) Performance run report (latency, throughput), 4) Runbook for handoff with recommended configs.

anika-eng: Agree. Also include model configuration snippet in runbook. Example snippet: ```json
{
  "model": "rwd-opt-6b-q4",
  "batching": "auto",
  "kv_cache": true,
  "max_tokens": 512
}
```

mike-se: SE tasks: demo script + validation checklist. Eng tasks: provisioning, routing policy, caching, quantization test. Who owns monitoring dashboards?

sara-sales: Eng-ops will own the dashboards during POC. @anika-eng can set them up. I will list dashboard access for ACME SRE in the SOW.

mike-se: One blocker — ACME's security team wants an IP allowlist for callbacks and a private link for logs. Can we provide that within timeline?

anika-eng: Yes, we can provide IP ranges and temporary secure webhook tunnel. If they require VPC peering/on-prem connectors, that will add 1 week. Need to surface if ACME asks for it.

sara-sales: Good catch. I'll ask ACME today if they need VPC-level connectivity. If yes, we push timeline + update estimate.

james-legal: Also flag: if they request subprocessing addendum we need 48 hours to review.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: provision-dedicated-pool -> 1789460000 (tentative).

oliver-ps: For scheduling: propose kickoff Mon, then mid-POC demo end of week 2, final demo end of week 3. I’ll own demo slides.

sara-sales: Action items: 1) I’ll send SOW draft by EOD. 2) @anika-eng to produce infra + runbook template by Wed. 3) @mike-se to prepare SE checklist. 4) @james-legal to standby for SQ review. 5) @oliver-ps to draft demo plan.

mike-se: Sounds good. If anyone hits blockers ping #eng-oncall and tag me.

anika-eng: One more: we need the ACME eval prompts in CSV by next Tue so we can run them. Please request them in the kickoff meeting.

sara-sales: Will include in calendar invite. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
